summary.intent: Execute Phase 35 (Phala Testnet TEE Migration) end-to-end: restructure TEE worker into monorepo, add tests and Phala SDK integration, update staging infra and docs, and deploy a live CVM to Phala Cloud testnet.
summary.outcome: Waves 1-3 completed successfully (35-01 through 35-05, 19+ commits). Wave 4 (35-06) was partially completed: Phala Cloud API key and TEE_WORKER_SECRET set as GitHub secrets, branch pushed to remote, but CVM deployment blocked because the Docker image needs to be built and pushed to GHCR from the Docker host. Session paused with handoff doc for resume on Docker host.

repo: TEE worker moved from root `tee-worker/` to `apps/tee-worker/` as part of monorepo restructure.
Shared packages `@cipherbox/crypto`, `@cipherbox/core`, `@cipherbox/sdk-core` replace reimplemented logic in tee-worker (IPNS signing, ECIES encryption, provider interactions).
Staging deploy workflow (`deploy-staging.yml`) has `build-tee` and `deploy-tee-phala` jobs that build and push `ghcr.io/fsm1/cipherbox-tee-worker:latest` and deploy via Phala CLI.
Docker host is at 192.168.133.12 (was incorrectly recorded as 192.168.133.114 in memory).
TEE_WORKER_SECRET is stored in GitHub staging environment as `STAGING_TEE_WORKER_SECRET`; new value generated: `REDACTED/I=`.
Phala Cloud CVM deployment uses `apps/tee-worker/docker-compose.phala.yml` with `envsubst` + `phala deploy` CLI.
Phala CLI v1.1.13 installed globally on dev machine.

code.finding: Phala CVM docker-compose created in this phase; requires TEE_WORKER_SECRET and GHCR image as inputs for deployment.
Added deploy-tee-phala job that deploys to Phala Cloud using PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY and PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL environment variables.

workflow: Parallel agent worktree merges can produce STATE.md/ROADMAP.md conflicts; resolution is to take the later agent's version.
Git config lock errors occur when spawning multiple agents simultaneously sharing the same worktree — sequential execution avoids this.
GSD `phase-plan-index` returns `autonomous: false` for checkpoint plans requiring human interaction before automated work can continue.
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code bug means agent 'failure' with that error should be treated as success if SUMMARY.md exists and commits are present.
For checkpoint plans requiring external accounts/credentials, the GSD flow pauses and requests human input before continuing automation.

friction: Wave 2 parallel agent spawn caused git config lock error on 35-02 — had to clean up stale worktrees and run sequentially.
Usage limit hit mid-execution of 35-03 during Wave 2, requiring user to manually resume.
gsd-tools init failed initially because it was running from the main repo instead of the active worktree.
Docker not available on dev machine — image build requires SSH to Docker host at 192.168.133.12, breaking the automated deployment flow.
TEE_WORKER_SECRET not accessible locally (only in GitHub secrets), required generating a new one.
No Claude Code session transfer capability — requires manual handoff process to continue work on a different host.
open_items: Build and push `ghcr.io/fsm1/cipherbox-tee-worker:latest` image from Docker host (192.168.133.12) after pulling phase-35 branch.
Run `phala deploy` to provision the CVM on Phala Cloud testnet staging environment.
Verify CVM health endpoint and key determinism (Tasks 3-4 of 35-06).
Run end-to-end IPNS republish test against live Phala CVM (Task 4 of 35-06).
Capture latency baselines for CVM key derivation vs. local HKDF (Task 5 of 35-06).
Update ROADMAP.md and STATE.md to mark Phase 35 complete.
PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY `REDACTED` set in GitHub staging secrets — confirm it remains valid.
